2.prompt: close-up of a man's face in the dark lit from below by pale blue flames, he lifts a wooden ladle of burning liquid above a wide brown earthenware bowl of blue flames, blue fire dripping back into it, black background
2.texto: Coas luces apagadas, alguén pronuncia o conxuro mentres ergue cun cazo o líquido en chamas.

6.prompt: medium shot of an old midwife in a dark brown wool headscarf kneeling beside a heavily pregnant young woman lying on a straw mattress, stroking her brow, a burly bearded man watching from the dark doorway, candlelight, rough granite walls, 17th century
6.texto: que a parteira Dorotea do Barro dixera que podía quitarlle as dores do parto a unha muller e pasarllas a un home.

animacion.accion: the old midwife gently strokes the young woman's brow while the man shifts his weight

7.prompt: close-up of an old midwife in a dark brown wool headscarf kneeling on a rough wooden floor, pushing a small worn soft leather slipper onto a bearded man's large bare foot, candlelight, 17th century
7.texto: Abondaría con calzarlle ao home os zapatos da muller, dicindo unhas palabras que ela sabía.

animacion.accion: her hands slowly push the small shoe onto the man's foot

9.prompt: close-up of a single thin beeswax taper candle just lit in a simple wrought-iron holder on a rough dark oak table, a thin curl of smoke rising, rough granite wall behind in deep shadow, calm night
9.texto: Boas noites. A voz que vas escoitar é sintética, e este texto preparouno un proceso automático.

10.prompt: wide shot of two old Galician granaries raised on granite pillars with mushroom-shaped staddle stones, one of wood and one of granite, stone-tiled roofs, in a quiet village yard at dusk, soft mist, calm
10.texto: Isto é Cousas de Galiza para durmir.

17.prompt: medium shot of an old village woman sitting on a granite doorstep shelling beans into her lap, a young woman in a dark wool headscarf standing in the dark open doorway beside her, long dark wool skirts, soft evening light, 17th century
17.texto: Había mulleres de aldea detrás de todas esas palabras.

animacion.accion: the old woman shells beans while the young woman turns her head toward her

18.prompt: medium shot of an old village healer in a dark blue wool shawl handing a steaming clay bowl of herb infusion to a sick young woman lying under a wool blanket on a straw bed, dried herbs hanging from dark beams, firelight, smoke-blackened granite walls
18.texto: A meiga, moitas veces, non era a bruxa dos contos, senón a que curaba, a que axudaba nos partos, a que sabía de herbas.

animacion.accion: the healer slowly hands over the steaming bowl and the young woman takes it

20.prompt: medium shot of a woman of about thirty in a faded red wool headscarf standing before a plain wooden table where a stern grey-bearded judge in a black gown points his quill at her, bare granite walls, a narrow shaft of daylight
20.texto: En Vilalba, a Real Audiencia xulgou tamén a María do Barro, a filla de Dorotea.

animacion.accion: the judge points his quill at her and she lowers her eyes

21.prompt: wide shot of a woman in a faded red wool headscarf holding a horn lantern at the heavy wooden door of a thatched granite house at dusk, letting in a man in a dark wool cloak, 17th century Galicia
21.texto: Da filla dicían outra cousa: que era alcaiota, e que acollía na súa casa homes casados e mulleres solteiras.

animacion.accion: she opens the heavy door wider and the cloaked man steps inside

22.prompt: medium shot of two village women in dark wool headscarves and an old man whispering together beside the round-arched stone doorway of a small Romanesque granite church, one woman glancing sideways with suspicion, overcast daylight, 17th century
22.texto: Unha testemuña oíu murmurar entre algúns veciños que María era meiga, e que non era boa cristiá.

animacion.accion: they lean closer and whisper, and one woman glances sideways

29.prompt: wide shot of a stern priest in a black cassock reading a decree aloud at the door of a small rustic granite chapel, below him two women stand alone, an old one in a dark brown wool headscarf and a younger one in a faded red wool headscarf
29.texto: E as palabras tamén podían pechar portas. O vicario xeral do bispado de Mondoñedo excomungou a nai e a filla, e mandou que ninguén lles dese pan, sal, auga nin lume.

animacion.accion: the priest reads from the paper while the two women lower their heads

31.prompt: close-up of an old brass magnifying glass lying on a yellowed 17th-century manuscript of faded brown ink, shallow depth of field, the handwriting soft and blurred, soft daylight in a quiet archive
31.texto: Aquel papel gardou ata o máis pequeno, unha palabra trabucada.

38.prompt: wide shot of a village festival at night seen from behind the crowd, dark silhouettes raising small clay cups toward a wide clay bowl of pale blue flames on a stone table, the blue glow on their raised hands, 1980s
38.texto: Así, unhas palabras sen nome no papel acabaron parecendo de todos, e de sempre.

animacion.accion: people raise their cups and the blue flames flicker

39.prompt: overhead shot of a wide clay bowl of pale blue flames on the wooden deck of an old boat at night, the shoes and trouser legs of three men standing around it, coils of rope nearby, 1960s
39.texto: O conxuro naceu entre amigos, arredor dun pote.

40.prompt: wide shot of three judges seated side by side at a long wooden table in a bare granite hall: a grey-bearded judge in a black gown, a priest in a black cassock, an elderly friar in a white habit and black cape, light from a high opening
40.texto: As palabras dos procesos acabaron noutro sitio: nos tribunais. Tres xustizas podían xulgar a bruxería: a civil, a eclesiástica e a Inquisición.

animacion.accion: the judge in the black gown signs a paper while the others read

41.prompt: medium shot of a lean elderly friar with a grey tonsure, in a white habit and black cape, closing a thick bundle of trial papers tied with cord and laying it on a tall pile of bundles, single candle, bare stone room, 17th century
41.texto: Para o investigador Diego Valor Bravo, coas meigas galegas a temida Inquisición foi branda: en tres séculos só condenou a morte unha meiga.

animacion.accion: he closes the file and sets it on the pile

42.prompt: over-the-shoulder shot from behind a stern grey-bearded judge in a black gown at a high wooden table, looking down at three village women in dark wool headscarves seated on a rough bench below him, cold light from a high opening, bare granite hall
42.texto: Os xuíces civís foron moito máis duros. E nos procesos civís da Real Audiencia, todas as acusadas eran mulleres.

animacion.accion: the judge leans forward and the women lower their heads

44.prompt: medium shot of an old healer with white hair under a black wool headscarf at the door of her rough granite house, handing a small clay pot of ointment to a peasant woman holding a child, villagers waiting behind, soft morning light, 17th century
44.texto: Que llo ensinara a súa nai. Que á nai acudía moita xente, e que ela lles facía curas e menciñas.

animacion.accion: the old healer hands over the pot and touches the child's head

45.prompt: over-the-shoulder shot from behind a peasant woman in a grey wool headscarf on a stool: a stern grey-bearded judge in a black gown questions her while a gaunt clean-shaven scribe beside him writes with a quill, bare stone room, candlelight
45.texto: E que as noites de san Xoán as meigas ían ás xuntanzas do demo, nas areas de Sevilla. Diante dela, alguén preguntaba, e alguén escribía.

animacion.accion: the judge leans forward and asks while the scribe writes

46.prompt: close-up two-shot in profile: a stern grey-bearded judge in a black gown reads a question from a paper to a pale exhausted peasant woman in a grey wool headscarf, who nods in silence with her lips closed, candlelight
46.texto: Rodrigo Pousa, historiador, explica que aquelas mulleres non sabían que declarar: as respostas xa ían nas preguntas. Ás veces, a voz era dunha muller, e as palabras, de quen preguntaba.

animacion.accion: the judge reads the question and the woman slowly nods without speaking

47.prompt: wide shot of a simple rustic spring at night: water pouring from a stone spout set in a mossy granite wall into a stone trough, among chestnut trees, the faint orange glow of a distant bonfire between the trunks, moonlight
47.texto: Unha noite de san Xoán aparece tamén nos papeis de Campo Lameiro.

48.prompt: medium shot of two village men in sheepskin vests pointing and shouting at a village woman in a dark wool shawl at the door of a stone byre, a sick calf and two piglets lying still on the straw inside, overcast daylight, 17th century
48.texto: En mil seiscentos corenta e tres, a Real Audiencia procesou alí varias mulleres. Uns veciños, rifados cunha delas, culpábana de lles facer morrer as becerras e os leitóns.

animacion.accion: the men point and shout and the woman steps back

49.prompt: over-the-shoulder shot of two village men in sheepskin vests crouching behind a mossy granite wall at night, peering over it at distant women gathered around a small bonfire by a rustic stone spring, deep shadows
49.texto: Unha testemuña contou que, pola sospeita que tiñan delas, uns veciños foran espreitalas á fonte da Nogueira, a noite de san Xoán do ano anterior.

animacion.accion: the two men slowly raise their heads above the wall to look

51.prompt: close-up of cold water pouring from a rough stone spout in a mossy granite wall into a stone trough on a short June night, moonlight on the water, dark leaves and ferns all around
51.texto: Pensemos nunha noite curta de xuño: a auga fría da fonte, e uns ollos que miran desde a escuridade.

52.prompt: wide shot of three village women in dark wool shawls and headscarves talking and laughing softly around a rustic stone spring at night, lit by a small bonfire, seen from far away through dark branches
52.texto: Do que elas dixesen aquela noite, non nos chegou nin unha palabra. Só nos chegou a noticia da lista, na voz doutros.

animacion.accion: the women talk and gesture softly as the small fire flickers

54.prompt: close-up two-shot at a rustic stone spring at night: a young woman with a long dark braid smiles as she fills a clay jug at the spout, beside her an old woman in a black wool headscarf crosses herself, looking warily into the dark
54.texto: E na crenza popular, era tamén a noite en que as meigas andaban máis libres. A mesma fonte, a mesma noite, e dúas maneiras de mirala.

animacion.accion: the old woman slowly turns her head toward the darkness while the young woman fills the jug

58.prompt: medium shot of a stout round-faced Benedictine friar of about fifty in a black habit holding a sprig of a medicinal herb that an old village woman in a dark blue wool shawl offers him from her basket, monastery herb garden, 18th century
58.texto: Xa no século dezaoito, frei Martín Sarmiento defendeu o saber das curandeiras, as meigas, como o de auténticos médicos e botánicos.

animacion.accion: the friar turns the sprig in his fingers and nods as the old woman speaks

61.prompt: medium shot of a village woman asleep curled on her side under a wool blanket on a straw mattress in a dark granite room, her face calm, moonlight from a small opening, on the wall above her the soft shadow of a bird in flight
61.texto: E admitía que moitas veces o voo das bruxas era só soñado, aínda que non negaba que as houbese.

animacion.accion: the shadow of the bird drifts slowly across the wall while the woman sleeps

63.prompt: high-angle close-up of the full moon reflected in the still dark water of a stone trough under a rustic spring spout, ferns and moss around its edge, a thin stream falling, soft mist, night, no one around
63.texto: É outra vez aquela noite de xuño, e esta vez ninguén espreita na escuridade nin apunta nomes nunha lista.

64.prompt: a wide brown earthenware basin full of water with floating sprigs of fennel, ferns and wild flowers, resting on top of a mossy granite wall outside at night, dew drops on the leaves, moonlight, calm
64.texto: Para facer o cacho, alguén colle auga de sete fontes, coma naquelas palabras do monte, e deixa nela as herbas da véspera. A talla queda fóra toda a noite, para que lle caia o orballo, que segundo a crenza daba ás herbas as súas virtudes.

65.prompt: wide shot of a dark misty meadow at night, far away a low ring of dull red embers almost burnt out on the ground, small dark silhouettes of villagers around it, one leaping over the embers, deep blue darkness, calm
65.texto: Lonxe, cando a cacharela xa case se apaga, a xente salta as últimas lapas, sempre un número impar de veces, polo menos tres. E ao saltar di unhas palabras que ninguén apunta nunha lista. Salto por riba do lume de san Xoán, para que non me morda cadela nin can.

animacion.accion: a small figure leaps over the embers and sparks rise slowly

67.prompt: close-up of bunches of dried herbs and wild flowers hanging from a dark smoke-blackened wooden beam against a rough granite wall, dust floating in a thin beam of light, dim and quiet
67.texto: Despois, os ramos de herbas colgan secos nalgún lugar da casa, para que a protexan o resto do ano.

68.prompt: close-up of an old woman's hand pouring clear spirits from an earthenware jug into a wide clay bowl holding sugar, lemon peel and coffee beans, small clay cups hanging on its rim, dim room at night, faint warm light
68.texto: Outra noite, nunha cociña de aldea, tras a cea, apáganse as luces. No pote de barro van a augardente e o azucre, a casca de limón e uns poucos grans de café.

animacion.accion: the jug slowly pours the spirits into the bowl

69.prompt: medium shot of an old man with white stubble in a dark wool waistcoat lifting a clay ladle of pale blue flames over a wide clay bowl of blue flames, an old woman in a dark headscarf beside him, faces lit blue in a dark kitchen
69.texto: Os comensais xúntanse arredor do pote, para animar os corazóns. Un deles ergue cun cazo o líquido en chamas e déixao caer pouco a pouco no pote, mentres pronuncia o conxuro.

animacion.accion: he lifts the ladle and pours a slow stream of blue fire back into the bowl

70.prompt: wide calm view of a misty harbour at night, a small old wooden sailing boat moored at a granite quay, a faint blue glow and three small seated figures on its deck, still dark water, 1960s
70.texto: Mouchos, curuxas, sapos e bruxas. Agora xa sabes quen escribiu estas palabras, que parecían de ninguén: un home nun barco, entre amigos.

72.prompt: close-up of a wide brown earthenware bowl on a wooden table with a few faint low blue flames dying on its surface, the dark kitchen lit only by a dim red glow of embers, an old bundle of papers tied with a faded red cord beside it
72.texto: As lapas do alcohol van baixando amodo, ata que se esgota case todo, e a cociña queda á luz das brasas. Das meigas de verdade escoitamos esta noite poucas palabras, e todas quedaron escritas por outra man.

74.prompt: medium shot of two brown cows asleep on straw in a dark stone byre at night, bunches of dried herbs hanging from the wooden beam above them, fine rain falling outside the open half-door, the faint glow of a small horn lantern, calm
74.texto: Agora chove sobre as lousas do tellado, unha chuvia miúda e mansa, coma o orballo que caía sobre as herbas. Na corte, o gando dorme quente, e nalgún lugar da casa colgan as herbas secas da véspera, que aínda cheiran a monte.

77.prompt: close-up of fine rain falling on dark wet stone slates of an old roof at night, drops gathering and dripping from the edge, moss between the slates, deep blue darkness, calm
